notes:
Context: SignalFuse Atelier is a mid-market SaaS that builds a customer support + knowledge product used by multiple B2B customers. Started with Redwood hosted API in Nov 2024; performance/cost profile good but they want predictable throughput and lower per-token unit cost for peak chat workloads. Decided to run a Dedicated POC for production traffic carve-out.

POC goals: validate dedicated throughput for 120 req/s steady state (burst to 300), p50 latency target <= 150ms for short prompts, preserve quality at scale and reduce token cost by ~40% vs hosted baseline. Business ask: committed 6-month term with option to scale.

Technical plan (POC):
- Canary: deploy Dedicated pool in us-east-1, route 5% of prod traffic for 48-72h. Monitor latency, token cost, and quality regressions against hosted baseline.
- Fallback routing: automatic fallback to hosted_api variant in same region; secondary region failover configured to us-west-2 if us-east-1 capacity constrained.
- Model variants: quantized low-latency variant (7B-quant) for short-turn chat path; standard 13B-quality variant for long-form summarization/rerank. Canary will exercise both variants (split 70/30).
- Rollback policy: rollback to hosted if any of: p50 latency >1.5x baseline, error rate increase >2% absolute, or automated eval quality drop >3 points on key prompt set. Hold time after canary: 48h stable before scale.

Security/compliance: customer requires SSO/SAML, SOC2 evidence, audit logging and KMS integration for key management. Data residency note: primary tenant data remains in NA, legal insists on DPA changes.

Quotes/highlights from calls: "We need predictable costs for Q3 renewals — can't surprise customers on infra bills." — Head of Product. "If median goes above 200ms we'll pull traffic immediately." — CTO.

Commercial: pricing discussion in progress, asking for committed discount tiers and reserved GPU baseline with optional burst credits. AE/SE suggested 6-month reserved plan + 2-week ramp credits for onboarding.

Open asks: confirm final GPU SKU (H100 vs A100), provide SOC2 control package (missing infra diagrams), formal draft of DPA with data residency clauses.
